label: For "Asset Replacement Prioritisation": Rank assets for replacement or refurbishment under a capital budget by balancing failure risk, consequence and cost across the network. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Highest risk first only.
